scenarios.title: Ordering lunch at a café
scenarios.assistant_role: a friendly waiter at Rosie's Café in London
scenarios.situation: The learner is a customer at a small café in London and wants to order lunch.
scenarios.opening_line: Hi there! Welcome to Rosie's Café. What can I get you today?
goals: Order a drink and something to eat
Say how you want to pay

scenarios.title: Asking for directions
scenarios.assistant_role: a helpful local person on a street in a small English town
scenarios.learner_role: a tourist looking for the train station
scenarios.situation: The learner is a tourist who is lost and needs to find the train station.
scenarios.opening_line: Hello! You look a bit lost. Can I help you?
goals: Ask how to get to the train station

scenarios.title: Checking in at a hotel
scenarios.assistant_role: a polite receptionist at the Grand Hotel
scenarios.learner_role: a guest arriving in the evening
scenarios.situation: The learner arrives at a hotel in the evening and wants to check in.
scenarios.opening_line: Good evening, and welcome to the Grand Hotel. Do you have a reservation?
goals: Give your name and the dates of your stay

scenarios.title: Talking about your last holiday
scenarios.learner_role: someone who has just come back from a holiday
scenarios.situation: The learner has just returned to work after a holiday and a colleague asks about it.
scenarios.opening_line: Hey, welcome back! How was your holiday? Where did you go?
goals: Say where you went and who with
Compare the place with your home town
